radar.title: Model DNA & Capability Footprint
radar.subtitle: Multi-dimensional capability footprint across code, reasoning, tools, and context retention for smart tier routing.

overview.title: Welcome to SmartGate
overview.subtitle: Unified AI model gateway with intelligent capability routing, cost governance, and real-time observability.
overview.step1_desc: Group multiple upstream providers behind a unified model endpoint.
overview.step2_desc: Add your DeepSeek, Qwen, OpenAI, or custom LLM API keys.
overview.step3_desc: Create a secure API key bound to your authorized model services.
overview.step4_desc: Replace your base URL with SmartGate while retaining OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs.

services.title: Model services
services.no_services_desc: Model services provide unified routing endpoints grouping multiple upstream LLMs.
services.how_to_call_desc: Use the model service name as the model value in standard API calls.
services.how_to_call_hint: Use this service name as the model in client requests.
services.probe_modal_subtitle: Sends live targeted test cases to evaluate syntax logic, multi-step math, tool-calling schema, and constraint adherence.
services.probe_running_desc: Dispatching 5 live benchmark probes to upstream endpoint. This typically takes 5–15 seconds…
services.probe_ready_desc: Click below to benchmark and automatically calibrate this model for capability-aware intelligent routing.
services.no_models_match: No models match your search. You can enter a custom Model ID below.
services.custom_model_placeholder: e.g. deepseek/deepseek-r1:free or custom model identifier
services.create_tip: Add provider connections after creating the service. They will all use this model name.
services.remove_provider_confirm: Remove this model from the service?
services.edit_routing_desc: This applies to new requests for this model service.
services.judge_label: Use auxiliary judge model for complexity
services.judge_desc: When enabled, requests with ambiguous complexity are pre-checked by this lightweight model before routing to Pro or Flash.
services.judge_no_endpoints: Please connect at least one provider endpoint first.
services.api_key_placeholder: Leave blank to keep the current key
services.strategy_hub_desc: Choose how SmartGate optimizes cost, latency, and quality for your workload.
services.strategy_cost_desc: Automatically downshifts low-complexity queries to high-throughput Flash models, reserving flagship Pro models for complex tasks.
services.strategy_dna_desc: Dynamically scores endpoints based on calibrated 5D capability benchmarks tailored to your workload intent.
services.strategy_load_desc: Sends traffic toward providers with lowest active load and fastest response latency.
services.strategy_round_robin_desc: Distributes requests sequentially across all healthy connected providers with automatic fallback.
services.shadow_flighting_desc: Asynchronously mirrors a configurable percentage of live queries to a shadow model in the background.
services.shadow_target_desc: Must be a Model service authorized for the same API key.
services.shadow_no_targets: Create another Model service to use as the shadow comparison target.

evaluation.title: Model Evaluation & DNA Benchmarking
evaluation.subtitle: 5D multi-dimensional capability evaluation across Coding, Reasoning, Agent Tool Calling, Multilingual NLP, and Long Context.
evaluation.radar_desc: Visualizing capability footprints and structural strengths across connected LLMs.
evaluation.matrix_subtitle: Full benchmark breakdown and cost-efficiency comparison.
evaluation.no_models: No models or endpoints connected yet. Create a model service and add providers to view evaluations.

keys.title: API keys
keys.subtitle: Use these API keys in your applications, agents, or CLI to access authorized model services.
keys.authorized_services_desc: Select the model services this API key is permitted to call.
keys.created_notice: Copy or download this key now. It will not be shown again.
keys.usage_desc: Use this key with any OpenAI-compatible client. Set the base URL to this gateway and pass the model service name as the model.
keys.revoke_confirm_msg: Existing requests will not be interrupted.
keys.ready_desc: Create an API key and connect using OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses, or Anthropic Messages.
keys.profile_subtitle: Observed request statistics. This does not change routing.
keys.profile_quality_unavailable: Independent quality evidence is not available yet. These workload statistics do not represent a quality score.

analytics.title: Routing Analytics & Complexity Insights
analytics.subtitle: Inspect how incoming queries match complexity signals and route across Pro and Flash models.
analytics.spectrum_hint: Higher score routes to Pro models
analytics.table_subtitle: Live inspection of prompt intents and routed models.
analytics.no_records: No query records found for this period.

quality.title: Quality Assurance & Evaluation Dashboard
quality.subtitle: Verify that cost-optimized model routing preserves high output quality against the All-Pro baseline.
quality.preserved_rate_tip: Share of routed responses whose quality matches the configured flagship baseline, measured by comparative evaluation.
quality.preserved_rate_unavailable_tip: Requires an independent All-Pro baseline to be configured for comparative fidelity measurement.
quality.shadow_agreement_tip: How often the shadow flagship rerun agrees with the routed model for the same prompt, sampled by the auxiliary judge.
quality.shadow_agreement_unavailable_tip: No active shadow inference runs were sampled in this time period.
quality.correction_rate_tip: Share of requests followed by a retry or rephrased follow-up turn, a proxy for user dissatisfaction with the first answer.
quality.correction_rate_unavailable_tip: No completed requests were recorded in this period.
quality.schema_compliance_tip: Share of tool-call and structured-output requests that returned valid, schema-compliant JSON.
quality.schema_compliance_unavailable_tip: No requests containing tool calls or structured JSON schemas were recorded in this period.
quality.ab_benchmark_subtitle: Direct evidence comparing 100% All-Pro Flagship allocation against SmartGate Intelligent Routing.
quality.no_baseline_guide: No comparison baseline is configured yet.
quality.no_baseline_guide_desc: Select a flagship model (e.g. Pro) to enable real-time cost savings and latency speedup calculation.
quality.baseline_est_note: Cost is estimated from the configured baseline endpoint pricing; latency and quality metrics appear after real baseline traffic or a controlled A/B experiment.
quality.verdict_logs_subtitle: Live stream of verification sources, shadow judge scores, and auto-escalations.
quality.comparison_unavailable: No independent baseline is configured. Quality and savings comparisons are unavailable.
quality.no_records: No quality verification logs found for this period.
quality.session_cache_tip: Cache hit ratio per multi-turn session; a low ratio means the provider-side prefix cache is not being retained.

usage.title: Usage
usage.subtitle: Automatic statistics from your last 30 days of model calls.
usage.prompt_cache_subtitle: Provider-reported input tokens served from cache. This is separate from context trimming.
usage.no_cache_data: No provider-reported cache metrics are available for this period.
usage.usage_by_provider_sub: Each provider includes the models used through it.
usage.context_savings_sub: Signals produced by context reduction. This is separate from provider billing.
usage.savings_basis_desc: Estimated against the selected model service endpoint using recorded tokens and restored trimmed context; actual provider billing may differ.
usage.data_coverage_sub: Shows which requests use provider-reported tokens and which rely on estimates.
usage.configured_pricing_detail: {priced} of {total} requests have a pricing rule
usage.requests_without_tokens_sub: {count} requests below use a local estimate or have no token data.
usage.showing_first_10: Showing the first 10 provider and model groups.
usage.baseline_modal_desc: Choose one model from a Model Service as the comparison price.
usage.baseline_price_note: The estimate uses this endpoint’s configured prices. A single model is supported in the first version.
usage.create_service_first: Create a Model Service with at least one endpoint before configuring a baseline.
usage.tracking_desc: Your gateway is tracking spend and routing signals so you can make better model choices.

codex.title: Use Codex with SmartGate
codex.subtitle: Connect Codex GUI to a SmartGate model service through the OpenAI Responses API. Keep Codex as your coding workspace while SmartGate provides routing, provider fallback, budgets, and usage tracking.
codex.step1_desc: Connect providers and choose the routing strategy for Codex requests.
codex.step2_desc: Authorize the model service so Codex can call it using its service name.
codex.step3_desc: Add the Profile and model catalog below, then restart Codex with the Profile.
codex.profile_desc: Save this as {path}. Replace the path, endpoint, model name, and API key with values from this workspace.
codex.why_chat_desc: Codex uses the OpenAI Responses API, while SmartGate translates the request for the configured upstream. For the Fusion Profile, use {code} when the upstream does not accept the Responses API {param} parameter.
codex.catalog_desc: Save this as {path}. The {code} must match the model service name authorized for the API key.
codex.start_desc: Use the standalone Profile so Codex does not try to load the model catalog from the base configuration.
codex.restart_hint: Restart Codex after changing the Profile or model catalog.
codex.err_401_desc: check the project API key and service grant.
codex.err_reasoning_desc: use objects with {effort} and {description}, not strings.
codex.security_warning: Keep {token} private. Do not commit the Profile file when it contains a real key; restrict local permissions and rotate the key if it is exposed.
